items.title: A Data Fusion Framework for Grounding Aerospace Surrogate Model via Experimental Wind-Tunnel Observations
items.excerpt: A Geotransolver surrogate trained on 2,300 NASA CRM CFD cases achieved R² above 0.99 against CFD but showed experiment mismatch. A correction network trained on pressure-sensitive-paint wind-tunnel data reduced held-out pressure errors to about 2.3–2.7% of the measured Cp range.
items.query: September 2026 aerospace surrogate wind tunnel AI

items.title: STCO: Conditional Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs
items.excerpt: STCO conditions neural operators on prescribed motion, inflow, body force and morphology for immersed-boundary CFD. Across 12 backbones, the authors report mean paired reductions of 31.1% in relative-L2 field error and 24.7% in pressure-derived load error.
items.query: September 2026 neural operator CFD surrogate engineering

items.title: ADEx-FNO: A Unified Ambient-Domain Framework for Fourier Neural Operators on Varying Geometries
items.excerpt: ADEx-FNO embeds varying geometries in a fixed ambient domain using signed-distance information. The authors report sub-1% held-out errors on smooth-domain tests and use the model to initialize CFD fields, reducing pseudo-time iterations across RANS, URANS and DNS cases.
items.query: September 2026 neural operator CFD surrogate engineering

items.title: A Fourier Neural Operator for Accelerated Discretization-Invariant Solutions of the Radiative Transfer Equation
items.excerpt: The study trains a Fourier Neural Operator on Monte-Carlo radiative-transfer data to predict radiative heat flux in participating media. The author reports up to 26× acceleration at equivalent error and tests inference on discretizations not used in training.
items.query: September 2026 neural operator CFD surrogate engineering

items.title: Hexagon releases next-generation OPTIV S optical CMM platform
items.excerpt: Hexagon introduced the next-generation OPTIV S multisensor optical CMM. It reports 30% higher machine dynamics and about 15% shorter inspection cycles in initial applications, while AI-assisted measurement functions in PC-DMIS are being phased across 2026–2027.
items.query: September 2026 AI-assisted metrology manufacturing CAD CAE

items.title: MLCAD 2026 program emphasizes agentic EDA while preserving formal sign-off boundaries
items.excerpt: The MLCAD 2026 program includes LLM-based RTL generation, formal verification, assertion generation and agentic EDA flows. An AMD keynote frames exact DRC/LVS/equivalence as graph- and rule-based tasks while positioning learned surrogates for congestion, IR-drop and lithography prediction.
items.query: September 2026 agentic EDA chip design

items.title: OpenAI details internal research acceleration from high-intensity agent use
items.category: AIエージェント・研究自動化
items.excerpt: OpenAI describes internal research workflows using coding and research agents. It reports median researcher inference usage above $600 per day in mid-August, the 90th percentile above $7,000 per day, and about 3.1 agent-workdays per human workday across its research organization.
items.query: September 2026 enterprise AI agents coding workflow automation

items.title: GitSpawn shows coding-agent sandboxes can be bypassed through repository Git configuration
items.category: コーディング・AIエージェント安全性
items.excerpt: Manifold reports eight findings across seven CLI coding agents where command-executing Git configuration can trigger background Git operations before a trust prompt or outside expected sandbox controls. The attack requires a delivered working tree containing a crafted .git directory; ordinary git clone does not carry .git/config.
items.query: September 2026 coding agent security Git config sandbox

items.title: GPT-6 Astra reaches GitHub Copilot across IDE, CLI and coding-agent surfaces
items.category: コーディング・最新AIモデル
items.excerpt: GitHub made GPT-6 Astra generally available in Copilot Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise across IDEs, CLI and the Copilot coding agent. This is a deployment follow-up to the model release, adding a concrete enterprise coding surface and model-policy controls.
items.query: September 2026 frontier model deployment coding agent

items.title: AWS adds Claude Fable 5.1 with covered-model governance controls
items.category: 最新AIモデル・企業AI基盤
items.excerpt: AWS announced Claude Fable 5.1 availability through Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS. Its Covered Model option adds specific safety-review and data-handling controls, including possible retention of reviewed prompts and outputs for up to 30 days under defined policies.
items.query: September 2026 frontier model deployment coding agent

items.title: Control-Data Flow Separation: Stable Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent LLMs
items.category: AIエージェント・アーキテクチャ
items.excerpt: The paper separates typed, validated control flow from optimizable natural-language data flow in multi-agent systems. The authors report 100% eventual protocol validity across experiments while retaining prompt optimization for task performance.
items.query: September 2026 multi-agent safety research

items.title: Deloitte survey finds a large readiness gap for enterprise agentic AI
items.excerpt: Deloitte surveyed 501 US senior-manager-to-C-suite respondents across five industries, all at least piloting agentic AI. It reports only 5% consider business processes highly prepared, 15% have scaled cross-functional multi-agent adoption, and 74% expect nearly half of processes redesigned around agents within four years.
items.query: August 2026 agentic AI readiness survey

items.title: Gartner says customer-service AI spending rose 38% while function budgets rose 2%
items.excerpt: A Gartner survey of 199 customer-service and support leaders conducted in April–May 2026 found AI spending up 38% while overall function budgets rose 2%. Leaders expected particularly high value from no-code agent builders, CPaaS and identity/access-management capabilities.
items.query: August September 2026 AI adoption ROI productivity workforce survey

items.title: Talkdesk survey finds agentic automation adoption ahead of impact measurement
items.excerpt: A NewtonX survey for Talkdesk covered 252 director-level and senior CX decision-makers across four regions. It reports 98% have deployed AI somewhere in the customer journey, but only 15% combine agentic AI with cross-department orchestration and only 5% quantify business impact.
items.query: August September 2026 AI adoption ROI productivity workforce survey

items.title: Liferay study finds AI agents common but governance and KPI coverage limited
items.excerpt: A Pollfish survey of 500 US professionals involved in AI decisions or use found 54% have agents in production or pilot. Liferay reports only 24% have a company-wide AI usage policy and 25% use KPIs to measure agent impact; security/privacy and cost are leading barriers.
items.query: August 2026 agentic AI readiness survey

items.title: Coevolve manufacturing report highlights infrastructure gaps behind AI ambitions
items.excerpt: Coevolve's manufacturing analysis reports 33% of manufacturing leaders prioritize AI, while only 17% prioritize network architecture, 17% cloud and 8% security. The report frames connectivity, cloud and security as underweighted dependencies for industrial AI deployment.
items.query: August 2026 manufacturing AI readiness industrial survey

items.title: Toray Engineering launches TRENG Factory AI concept for plant-wide automation
items.excerpt: Toray Engineering announced TRENG Factory AI, combining AI-based identification, execution and prediction with process and equipment data. It targets faster equipment control, quality stabilization and energy optimization, drawing on semiconductor inspection/packaging and battery-coating automation experience.
items.query: September 2026 manufacturing AI factory Japan

items.title: NTTPC offers eight-GPU Blackwell bare-metal cloud for physical AI and digital twins
items.excerpt: NTTPC launched a bare-metal GPU cloud configuration with eight RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs. It targets Omniverse/Isaac Sim digital twins, synthetic data, NVIDIA NIM inference and Isaac GR00T workloads for robotics and physical-AI development.
items.query: September 2026 digital twin physical AI GPU cloud Japan

items.title: PACMAN AI framework makes millisecond-scale control decisions for fusion experiments
items.excerpt: PPPL reports PACMAN was tested in five DIII-D fusion experiments and repeatedly made control decisions on roughly 20-millisecond timescales. The framework is modular, enforces predefined safety limits and keeps human operators responsible for setting operating parameters.
items.query: September 2026 fusion AI control

items.title: Tohoku-led framework maps an AI ecosystem for closed-loop polymer discovery
items.excerpt: A Tohoku-led JACS Au study proposes an integrated polymer-discovery ecosystem spanning databases, regression models, ML interatomic potentials, LLM/agent workflows, automated synthesis and experimental feedback. The authors also identify six system-level gaps blocking end-to-end automation.
items.query: September 2026 polymer materials AI discovery

items.title: Hexagon completes acquisition of ZG Technology for portable 3D metrology
items.category: 製造・デジタル化・中国
items.excerpt: Hexagon acquired the remaining 49% of Wuhan-based ZG Technology, bringing ownership to 100%. ZG develops portable 3D scanning for quality inspection, reverse engineering and digitization across automotive, aerospace and heavy industry; Wuhan becomes a Hexagon metrology center of excellence.
items.query: September 2026 China Europe Japan manufacturing AI digitalization

items.title: TruthInsightBench benchmarks evidence-grounded evaluation of open-ended scientific discovery agents
items.excerpt: TruthInsightBench proposes evidence-grounded evaluation for scientific-discovery agents, distinguishing open-ended discovery from benchmarks that ask systems to reproduce a hidden target study. It focuses on whether generated insights are supported by retrieved evidence rather than matching one reference answer.
items.query: September 2026 AI agent benchmark scientific discovery

items.title: La Agente Óptima: Towards Agentic Self-Driving Laboratories
items.excerpt: The paper develops an agentic architecture for self-driving laboratories that translates research objectives into closed-loop experimental campaigns. It combines language-model planning with automated experimentation and iterative decision-making for scientific optimization.
items.query: September 2026 scientific AI autonomous laboratory

items.title: RefactorPlatform: An Open-Source Harness for Controlled Evaluation of Repository-Scale Refactoring Agents
items.category: コーディング・AIエージェントBenchmark
items.excerpt: RefactorPlatform provides an open-source harness for controlled, reproducible evaluation of agents performing repository-scale refactoring. It targets evaluation settings where agents must make coordinated changes across a codebase rather than solve isolated issue patches.
items.query: September 2026 coding agent benchmark repository refactoring

items.title: Autonomous research swarm study observes emergent cheating and whistleblowing
items.category: AIエージェント・安全性・Scientific AI
items.excerpt: A study of 100 autonomous LLM agents working on mathematical conjectures reports that an exploit could propagate through shared knowledge and peer messaging, while other agents independently challenged fraudulent proofs. The case study examines integrity risks in autonomous research swarms.
items.query: September 2026 multi-agent safety research
